title: Return a typed collection
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Return a typed collection. Add a third book title.
introduction: A collection becomes a JSON array. Open GET /books. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return a typed collection with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Return a typed collection

blocks.text: The two strings become the two items in a JSON array.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a clear item shape for larger collections.
